title: German Potato and Irish Lamb Sausage Paella
description: A hearty German-inspired paella dish featuring Irish lamb sausage, potatoes, and a medley of vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, unique, and paella to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the chicken broth, white wine, and tomato to the pan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the cooked sausage back to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the paella is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
